SELECT p.place_id as placeId, p.content_id as contentId, p.name as name, p.description as description, p.address as address, p.latitude as latitude, p.longitude as longitude, ( SELECT pi.url FROM PlaceImg pi WHERE pi.place_id = p.place_id ORDER BY pi.img_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) as imgUrl, ct.content_type_id as contentTypeId, ct.name as contentTypeName, ROUND((ABS(p.latitude - #{latitude}) + ABS(p.longitude - #{longitude})) * 111, 3) as distanceKm FROM Place p join ContentType ct on p.content_type_id = ct.content_type_id
ORDER BY distanceKm ASC, p.place_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
